flags.message: Predictions and outcome concern different petitions. All three predictions were provisioned (2026-08-21 truncated snapshot) with Nathan v. Alamo Heights ISD (en banc CA5, Ten Commandments; 26A15 extension in its proceedings), and this event's event.yaml carries that title. Docket 9026000221 / No. 26-221 as now stored (2026-10-13 snapshot) is Purdy v. Kansas (Kansas Ct. App., Confrontation Clause), denied 2026-10-13, and the sibling event evt-petition-disposition carries the Purdy title. outcome.json records Purdy's denial. The evaluations were scored mechanically against it (correct 0, Brier p^2), but these scores do not measure forecast skill on the petition that was forecast. Recommend checking the live-channel docket-number mapping and the arrival event's provisioning, and excluding or re-grading this cell.
